entries.appliesTo: University System of Maryland (AI Partnership, Fellowship, Incubation Lab), Morgan State University's Center for Equitable AI, and the Department of Information Technology

params.program: AI Partnership + Technology Extension Hubs + Incubation Lab + Public Service Fellowship + Emerging Technology scholarships

sources.program: § 12-124(B)(1) — 'THERE IS A MARYLAND ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE PARTNERSHIP IN THE UNIVERSITY SYSTEM OF MARYLAND'; § 12-124(A)(2) — '"HUB" MEANS A MARYLAND TECHNOLOGY EXTENSION HUB'; § 12-126(B)(1) — 'THERE IS AN ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE INCUBATION LAB IN THE UNIVERSITY SYSTEM OF MARYLAND'; § 12-125(B) — 'THERE IS AN ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE PUBLIC SERVICE FELLOWSHIP IN THE UNIVERSITY SYSTEM OF MARYLAND'; § 18-3502(a) — 'a scholarship program known as the [Cybersecurity] EMERGING TECHNOLOGY Public Service Scholarship Program'

flags: No company compliance duties, no penalty or enforcement provisions anywhere in the act — programs-only act binding state universities and agencies (exposure omitted; silence is silence).

Strategic plan mandate: § 12-124(C)(1)(I) — 'ON OR BEFORE DECEMBER 1, 2026, THE PARTNERSHIP SHALL DEVELOP A STRATEGIC PLAN', with annual progress reports per § 12-124(C)(2) — 'ON OR BEFORE DECEMBER 1, 2027, AND EACH DECEMBER 1 THEREAFTER, THE PARTNERSHIP SHALL SUBMIT A PROGRESS REPORT' to the Governor and General Assembly; internal government reporting, no fixed-vocabulary duty/param fits.

Maryland Technology Extension Hubs pilot: § 12-124(D)(2) — 'ON OR BEFORE DECEMBER 15, 2026 2027, THERE SHALL BE ONE HUB IN EACH OF THREE REGIONS OF THE STATE ESTABLISHED ON A PILOT BASIS' (strike/insert artifact; effective deadline is December 15, 2027); hubs must 'PROVIDE ARTIFICIAL IN TELLIGENCE SKILLS TR AINING TO INDIVIDUALS AT NO CH ARGE'.

Incubation Lab is conditional: § 12-126(B)(1) — 'SUBJECT TO A MEMORAND UM OF UNDERSTANDING BETWEEN THE UNIVERSITY SYSTEM OF MARYLAND AND THE DEPARTMENT OF BUDGET AND MANAGEMENT, THERE IS AN ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE INCUBATION LAB'.

Morgan State research role: § 14-111(B)(3) requires the Center for Equitable AI and Machine Learning Systems to submit research reports to the Governor's AI Subcabinet and the Joint Committee on Cybersecurity, Information Technology, and Biotechnology — 'THE CENTER FOR EQUITABLE ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE AND MACHINE LEARNING SYSTEMS SHALL SUBMIT A REPORT'.

Education-adjacent provisions: § 11-1402(b) adds AI to the Cyber Warrior Diversity Program training purpose — 'computer networking [and], cybersecurity, AND ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE'; §§ 18-3501 to 18-3504 rename the Cybersecurity Public Service Scholarship Program to the 'EMERGING TECHNOLOGY Public Service Scholarship Program' and extend eligibility to 'cybersecurity OR ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE' — student-facing higher-ed funding binding public institutions and scholarship recipients, not a school-district mandate, so kept in this public-sector entry rather than education-k12.
Category judgment: bill is housed in higher education but binds the University System, DoIT, and state agencies rather than K-12 schools/districts/curricula, so 'public-sector' over 'education'.
Chaptered text shows strike/insert artifacts (e.g. 'DECEMBER 15, 2026 2027' and renumbered clauses '(IV) (III)'); quotes preserve the printed enrolled text including OCR spacing.
